versions.name: RXV2-0.9.506-cyclic-balance
versions.notes: Travel extents: cyclic gain split into separate roll and pitch gains so the two axes can be balanced against the pitch gauge (8 vs 10 degrees is now fixable).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.505-blades-on-step
versions.notes: New wizard step before Back up: blades back on, check main and tail pitch with a gauge, sweep full travel for mechanical issues.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.504-servo-power-warning
versions.notes: Wiring and Servos pages warn: do not power the servos until their frequency/pulse width and the BEC voltage are set - wrong settings can damage them.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.503-banner-wording
versions.notes: Calibrate-page banner reworded: from here on everything is done from your phone via the receiver.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.502-computer-notes
versions.notes: Step 1 notes the receiver need not be connected and that the post-flash 'calibration needed' warning can be ignored (or calibrate right there); step 2 opens with 'from here on everything is done from the receiver'.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.501-calibrate-first
versions.notes: Flight-controller calibration is now wizard step 2 with its own page (on the desk, before mounting) and an A-la-carte entry; also fixes the 'Can't find variable: LDRC' race on First-time basics.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.500-gear-mentions-gone
versions.notes: Setup-page button and help texts no longer mention gear ratio (it lives in the Rotorflight area now); dead gear code removed from Diagnostics.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.499-gear-in-wizard
versions.notes: Gear ratio moves into the Rotorflight area: editable card in the wizard's ESC step, its own page in A la carte (with live head speed), removed from Receiver settings.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.498-governor-why
versions.notes: ESC page now explains WHY Rotorflight's governor wins: it feeds throttle the instant collective demands it, before head speed sags - an ESC governor only reacts after the RPM drop.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.497-selectors-stay
versions.notes: Bank and Rates rows lose their delete (x) button - choosing None in the channel picker already covers the rare case; Rescue keeps its x.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.496-no-end-blobs
versions.notes: Bank/Rates bars on both screens lose their end blobs - the travel is pinned to CRSF's known 988-2012 us, so there was nothing to drag.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.495-one-divider
versions.notes: Arming and Rescue bars: the useless end blobs are gone - ONE draggable divider sits on the OFF/ON threshold.
